text_blocks.snippet: The most common side effects of Jardiance are urinary tract infections and yeast infections.
snippet_highlighted_words: urinary tract infections and yeast infections

list.snippet: More frequent urination: Your body removes extra sugar through urine, which makes you pee more often.
Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Sugar in the urine helps bacteria grow, causing burning or pain when you pee.
Yeast infections: These can happen in the vaginal area or around the penis due to extra sugar.
Thirst and mild dehydration: Losing extra fluid can make you feel very thirsty or dizzy.

text_blocks.snippet: Get medical help right away if you notice these rare but dangerous problems:

list.snippet: Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A dangerous buildup of acid in the blood. Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, trouble breathing, and unusual tiredness.
Severe dehydration: Causes extreme dizziness, confusion, or fainting when you stand up.
Fournier's gangrene: A rare, serious bacterial infection of the tissue between and around the anus and genitals. Symptoms include severe pain, swelling, redness, and fever.
Low blood sugar (hypoglycemia): More likely if you take Jardiance with insulin or other diabetes medicines.
